assumptions.text: SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE is sufficient for the bounded single-node pilot concurrency target.
assumptions.test: Run 100 concurrent reservation attempts and assert exact capacity plus contiguous FIFO queue positions.

decisions.title: Use atomic database transactions instead of in-memory capacity counters
decisions.choice: SQLite transaction plus partial unique indexes and idempotency records
decisions.rationale: The choice makes oversell prevention executable and auditable under concurrent requests.
alternatives: In-memory lock; distributed lock; eventual reconciliation

risks.title: Pilot storage is single-node only
risks.mitigation: Treat this as a bounded dogfood slice; require PostgreSQL or equivalent before multi-node production.
risks.trigger: More than one application process writes the same inventory.

pm-ready.purpose: 确认问题、战略、范围、成功指标和关键风险足以进入设计。

design-ready.purpose: 确认核心流程、状态、可访问性和交付规格达到可开发状态。

build-ready.purpose: 在大规模编码前确认架构、边界、测试、安全和迁移方案。

verification-ready.purpose: 确认实现已完成工程自证，可交给独立 QA。

release-ready.purpose: 确认残余风险已知、可接受，并有证据支持发布建议。

production-ready.purpose: 确认线上版本可监控、可验证、可回滚、可响应。

learning-decision.purpose: 把真实结果转成明确的继续、停止、修复或回流决策。

learning.expected: Atomic capacity allocation prevents oversell and FIFO cancellation promotes exactly the earliest waiter.
learning.actual: All 11 tests, the 200-request probe and eight deployment smoke checks passed in the recorded environment.
learning.gap: No engineering correctness gap was observed; real-user conversion and long-running production behavior remain unknown.
learning.decision: Keep the implementation as a pilot and route product-outcome validation back to PM discovery.
